verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents its own low-effort ways to take online payments: Payment Links, which it calls "the easiest way", and a pre-built Hosted Payment Page. Sandbox signup is instant, and a quickstart completes an end-to-end payment, but only in the sandbox, which is test-only with no real money. Live acceptance depends on a business-account application that is restricted by country and "does not guarantee approval", and nothing documents a same-day activation timeline. Missing for 10: any documented time-to-live or same-day production activation, evidence that card acceptance is enabled immediately after approval, and independent or hands-on reports of first live payment speed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept an online card payment within a day of signing up

citations.quote: Payment Links are the easiest way for you to accept payments online without a digital storefront.
Hosted Payment Page is a secure, pre-built payment page hosted by Airwallex that lets you accept multiple payment methods with a single integration.
Complete a minimal end-to-end online payment in the sandbox environment using Airwallex.js and Airwallex-hosted payment page.
This geographic requirement does not guarantee approval; other account eligibility criteria also apply.
